criteria.criterion: `scripts/gen_config_reference.py` generates `docs/config-reference.md` and `docs/security.md` whole from `rebar._config_schema`, `rebar._deprecations.REGISTRY`+`tombstones()` (cfg lifecycle), and `rebar._child_env._ADAPTER_SECRET_NAMES`, plus a curated template constant, and never writes `docs/config.md`.
`docs/config.md` is byte-unchanged and all its enumerated consumers remain intact, proven by a test that the generator/`--check` do not target `config.md`.
Across `docs/config-reference.md` and `docs/security.md`, an anchor exists for every topic in the REQUIRED_TOPICS list, proven by a topic-coverage test.

`docs/config-reference.md` carries a top-of-file banner (within its first 8 lines) naming `python scripts/gen_config_reference.py`, and `docs/security.md` carries the same, satisfying `test_generated_surface_markers.py::test_text_surface_carries_a_banner`.

Both new docs are registered in the `GENERATED` map of `tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py` and in the `docs/README.md` `### Generated — never edit these by hand` table, so `test_readme_table_matches_registry` passes.

`gen.main(["--check"])` returns 0 on committed docs and nonzero on a stale doc, is exercised by `tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py` under `make test` with no CI dependency, and does NOT false-fail on a CRLF checkout.
`docs/README.md` and `docs/architecture.md` navigation reference the new docs.
